ml1m_ratings.description: 1,000,209 user-movie ratings with timestamps (MovieLens-1M). The event stream every behavioral feature is built from.

user_id.description: MovieLens user id (1-6040). Join key to ml1m_users.

movie_id.description: MovieLens movie id (1-3952). Join key to ml1m_movies.

rating.description: Whole-star rating 1-5. The observed event itself; aggregates over ratings must be as-of prediction time.

timestamp.description: Seconds since epoch. THE prediction-time anchor: a feature is PIT-correct only if it reads rows with timestamp <= the scored row's timestamp.

liked.description: Derived label: rating >= 4. The prediction target.

ml1m_users.description: 6,040 users: volunteered demographics (gender, age bucket, occupation code, zip). Static per user.

ml1m_movies.description: ~3,900 movies: title (with release year), pipe-separated genres.

movie_id.description: Join key to ml1m_ratings and imdb_enrichment.movieId.

title.description: IMDb title including release year, e.g. 'Toy Story (1995)'.

imdb_enrichment.description: IMDb bulk-data join: 86% of movies, 94% of ratings. Downloaded offline from datasets.imdbws.com; refresh = re-download.

tconst.description: IMDb title id (tt0114709). Join key to wikidata_movies.

runtimeMinutes.description: Runtime in minutes. Time-invariant, safe raw. Sparse for obscure titles.

directors.description: IMDb name ids (nm...) pipe-separated, from title.crew. Time-invariant. Overlaps wikidata_movies.directors.

imdb_averageRating.description: ALL-TIME aggregate (votes through crawl date). LEAKAGE if used raw to score a 2001 rating.

imdb_numVotes.description: ALL-TIME vote count. Same leakage warning as averageRating.

wikidata_movies.description: Wikidata crawl keyed by IMDb tconst (P345): directors, cast, awards, box office, budget, release date, language. Crawled offline by src/crawl_wikidata.py; entity refs are QIDs (labels resolved for directors/awards/languages).

directors.description: Director QIDs, |-separated. Time-invariant. Overlaps imdb_enrichment.directors (different id space).

cast.description: Cast-member QIDs, |-separated (can be dozens per film). Time-invariant. Useful for cast-track-record features.

awards.description: Award QIDs (P166), |-separated, CURRENT as of crawl date. FAIL-CLOSED all_time: a film may have won awards AFTER prediction time, so raw use leaks the future. Needs award-date filtering for PIT-correct use.

box_office_amount.description: Box-office gross (P2142), raw amount. ALL-TIME final gross; MIXED CURRENCIES across films. Leakage if raw; needs normalization + PIT care.

budget_amount.description: Production budget (P2130), raw amount. Set pre-release so time-invariant in principle, but VERY sparse on Wikidata. Mixed currencies.
